text:
A: The game state is open. The turn player may perform any appropriate action. Every Phase and Step begins here.
From A: the turn player takes an action that does NOT start a Chain; activates a card or effect that starts a Chain (go to D); or passes (go to E).
After an action that does not start a Chain: Does this activate a triggered effect? Monster Trigger Effects, Continuous Spells/Traps that trigger. YES: go to D. NO: go to B.
B: Turn Player can activate a fast effect. ACTIVATE: go to D. PASS: go to C.
C: Opponent can activate a fast effect. ACTIVATE: go to D. PASS: return to A.
D: Chain Rules. Build, then resolve, the Chain. The effects that started the Chain go at the bottom of the Chain. Build the Chain from there, starting with the player who did NOT activate the most recent Chain Link. As you build the Chain, players may add to the Chain, or pass. If both players pass in a row, resolve the Chain. Refer to Rulebook for more details. After a Chain Resolves: check whether this activates a triggered effect; YES: D, NO: B.
E: The opponent can activate fast effects. ACTIVATE: D. PASS: Do both players agree to move to the next Phase/Step? NO: return to A. YES: End of Phase/Step; proceed to the next Phase/Step. If the End Phase just ended, it is now the opponent's turn, starting with the Draw Phase.
